The '''Loaded Savrip''' was a [[Casino/Legends|casino]] located along the Path of Coins in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Worlport/Legends|Worlport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]].

==Description==
[[File:Fight_Night_The_Loaded_Savrip_Proudly_Presents_Flutterplume.png|thumb|left|200px|Fight Night - The Loaded Savrip proudly presents... [[Aimee Kraeff|Flutterplume]].]]
Located along the bustling Path of Coins, the Loaded Savrip was a middle-class casino that catered to tourists seeking table games. The games, weighted heavily for the house, rarely attracted locals. Beneath the casino were three arenas used for staging pit fights, which could be accessed by a hidden entrance at the back of the casino floor.<ref name="MPQ" />

The casino's entrance is marked by a towering hologram of a [[Mantellian Savrip/Legends|Savrip]], with trousers overflowing with [[Credit chip/Legends|credits]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] served as concierge on the casino floor, while [[Jyd Renyr]] was the manager of the arena.<ref name="MPQ" />
